period_note: SOLO basis, same source PDF pattern as 2026_Q1.json (a 'NRBC Bank PLC. & Its Subsidiary Consolidated' set of statements followed by a separate SOLO 'NRBC Bank PLC.' set later in the PDF; the bank's own website labels the download link both 'Half Yearly Report June 30, 2026' and 'Half Yearly Report June 30, 2026(CFS)' but both point to the identical single PDF containing both bases -- the '(CFS)' label is a site quirk, not a separate file). Per project convention this Half-Yearly (Jan-Jun) filing is used as the Q2 data point, on the SOLO/standalone statements, consistent with this bank's FY2020+ annual and 2026_Q1.json basis. This filing usefully discloses THREE columns for the P&L: Jan-Jun (cumulative), and a bonus Apr-Jun (discrete) column -- both are recorded here, primary/discrete fields being Apr-Jun and '_cumulative' fields being Jan-Jun, matching this bank's own 2025_Q2.json convention. EXTRACTION NOTE: same pdftotext font-encoding corruption as 2026_Q1.json; all figures read directly off rendered page images (300dpi), not tesseract OCR'd. VALIDATION: total_assets = total_liabilities + total_equity (259,025,461,905 + 14,247,179,347 = 273,272,641,252) exactly; equity components (8,286,495,343 + 4,011,084,221 + 159,751,643 + 1,789,848,140 = 14,247,179,347) exactly; statutory_reserve = 2025_Q1-equivalent prior balance (3,905,896,381) + cumulative H1 appropriation (105,187,840) = 4,011,084,221 exactly; cumulative operating income - expenses = profit before provision (4,370,405,938 - 2,863,527,577 = 1,506,878,361, matches reported 1,506,878,360 within BDT 1 rounding); cumulative PBT - tax = cumulative PAT (525,939,202 - 26,359,132 = 499,580,070) exactly; discrete PBT - tax = discrete PAT (444,941,592 - (-525,559,089... using printed -525,559,089) = 970,500,681 -- superseded by direct check: discrete PBT (-164,540,165) - discrete tax (-525,559,089) = 361,018,924, matches reported discrete PAT 361,018,925 within BDT 1 rounding. STRONGEST cross-check: discrete-Q2 PAT (361,018,925) + Q1's discrete PAT from 2026_Q1.json (138,561,145) = 499,580,070, matching this filing's own H1-cumulative PAT (499,580,070) exactly -- confirms both quarters were read correctly. Net interest income fell to a near-zero 37.86m cumulative (from 1,751.00m in the comparable Jan-Jun 2025 period per this filing's own comparative column) and was outright NEGATIVE in the discrete Apr-Jun 2026 quarter alone (-99,306,779) -- unusual but reported as-is; consistent with this dataset's established sector-wide funding-cost-pressure pattern (see also CITYBANK's FY2025 negative discrete-Q3 NII finding) and this bank's own multi-year margin compression already documented in ratios_timeseries.json. No classified-loan/NPL breakdown is disclosed anywhere in this filing -- only available annually; npl_pct is intentionally omitted here, consistent with this bank's other interim quarters in this dataset.
